subject: Scoped SIG pass: Vendr evidence trimming & owner mapping
messages:
From: Evan Price <evan.price@vendr.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Singh <nora.singh@brightleaf.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr portal: initial manifest for SIG/CAIQ mapping

Hi Karthik,

Nice to meet you over email — thanks for the quick intake. Attached is a compressed manifest export from Brightleaf's Vendr profile (vendr_manifest_v2.csv). It includes the CAIQ fragments and pointers to evidence objects (S3/SharePoint).

We can:
- Provide a CAIQ JSON export (fragments per control)
- Drop a zipped evidence bundle onto a presigned S3 staging bucket you provide
- Or grant scoped read-only access to our Vendr tenant for your security team for a two-week window

Questions for your intake:
1) Do you want a full SIG mapping or a scoped SIG pass limited to high-risk controls (data flows, key management, and egress)?
2) Preferred evidence handoff: presigned S3 or emailed links?
3) Target sprint length for profile clean-up / evidence curation?

I included Nora from Brightleaf since they'll own portal approvals.

Attachments: vendr_manifest_v2.csv (csv, 210KB)

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Price
Vendor Success — Vendr
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evan Price <evan.price@vendr.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: initial manifest for SIG/CAIQ mapping

Evan — thanks for the manifest and quick context. A few points from our side so we can scope the work: 

- We want a scoped SIG pass: focus on SIG categories hit by Brightleaf's risk profile (SR, DSI, CR, and IV). If you can tag evidence by control id in the CSV that helps triage.
- Presigned S3 staging is our preference for ingestion (keeps audit trail). Please send a TTL window and key prefix you expect to use.
- Timeline: propose a 10 business-day curation sprint with a brief handoff call on day 3 to align owners and on day 9 for signoff.

Action items for you:
- Confirm you can emit CAIQ fragments as separate JSON files (soc2_caiaq_fragment.json is ideal)
- Share S3 presign instructions or a portal read-only account and which evidence items are time-limited

Marissa — can you own the evidence ingestion and mapping? Ben — can you run a SOC 2 quick-gap on the provided fragments once Evan pushes them?

Also, we'll need a short mutually-agreed MOA for access — I attached a signed copy of our standard MOA for Vendr.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-06-17T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: initial manifest for SIG/CAIQ mapping

Karthik —

Thanks, yes we can do the scoped pass you described. Quick answers:
- We will emit CAIQ fragments (JSON) per control and attach control_id tags in the CSV.
- I will generate a presigned S3 upload bucket with a 14-day TTL and a prefix: brightleaf/vendr-evidence/ (I'll send the presigns in a separate email).
- We can also grant a read-only portal role (inventory_viewer) for your audit window if you prefer that instead.

I uploaded two things to the Vendr portal and shared links: https://vendr.app/portal/brightleaf/profile/manifest (manifest viewer) and a one-time export (soc2_caiaq_fragment.json). The presigned URLs will follow shortly.

Attachments: soc2_caiaq_fragment.json (JSON, 95KB)

Evan

On Thu, Jun 16, 2027 at 11:04 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Evan — thanks for the manifest and quick context. A few points from our side so we can scope the work:...
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-17T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: initial manifest for SIG/CAIQ mapping

Karthik / Ben —

I'll take owner for the ingestion and triage. Plan:
1) Day 0 (today) — pull the CAIQ fragments and snapshot the CSV manifest into our secure SharePoint workspace.
2) Day 2 — normalize control ids and tag anything flagged as ephemeral (temp creds, screenshots).
3) Day 4 — run a SOC 2 quick-gap pass and highlight 1-2 high-priority evidence shortfalls to ask Brightleaf to remediate.
4) Day 9 — internal signoff and handover to Customer Success before we mark the Vendr profile as "validated".

Ben — can you confirm you have capacity to do the quick-gap on Day 4 and that you want the portal read-only account or a presigned S3 export?

I'll also coordinate a 20-min sync with Evan + Nora for tomorrow to confirm owners; propose 10:00 AM PT.

—Marissa
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: initial manifest for SIG/CAIQ mapping

Quick confirmation — I can take the Day 4 SOC 2 quick-gap. Preference is the presigned S3 export for reproducibility and automated checksum verification, but a read-only portal role works if the export surface is limited.

I'll stand up the quick-gap template (mapping CSV -> COS control ids) and post results to our Secure SharePoint folder: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/SecOps/EXAMPLE (watch for the folder named brightleaf_vendr_snapshot).

Next steps: Evan — send presigned URLs and the portal read-only account details if you opt for that method. Nora — we'll only request remediation for items we can't reasonably accept as mitigations (screenshots, ephemeral creds).

Ben
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
